simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עֹמֶד (H5977) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עֹמֶד (ʻômed) means a spot (as being fixed) First listed occurrence: 2Chr 30 16.

definitions.full: H5977. omed [ עֹ֫מֶד ] noun [masculine] standing-place ; — only suffix after preposition עַלעָֿמְדָם׃ וַיָּקוּמוּ Neh 9:3 they stood up in their place (later equivalent of תַּחְתָּם ), 8:7 (no verb); with עָמַד 2Chr 30:16 ; 35:10 , ׳ע עַלעָֿמְדוֺ 34:31 ; עַלעָֿמְדָם וָאַעֲמִדֵם Neh 13:11 , so עַלעָֿמְדִי Dan 8:18 ; עָמְדִי אֵצֶל וַיָּבֹא 8:17 ; עַלעָֿמְדֶ֑ךָ עֲמֹד 10:11 .
